title: Synthetic chilled-water plant: chiller staging and condenser-water reset (generated by CAMBER)
summary: SYNTHETIC, generated locally by CAMBER (no download, no real building): one chiller and its cooling tower, with outdoor dry-bulb and wet-bulb, chiller power, chilled-water supply, return and flow, condenser-water supply and return and tower fan speed, every 15 minutes for three summer weeks with a heat wave, as five plants: a well-staged chiller, an oversized chiller that short-cycles, a chiller left on around the clock, a tower held at a fixed 85 F, and a tower reset with a high 80 F floor.
teaches: a short-cycling chiller and a chiller left on at night, which no open dataset shows
a condenser-water loop held at a fixed setpoint instead of reset with the wet-bulb
a reset that passes the check but saves little: reading the slope and the median
publisher: CAMBER (generated locally by the user's copy)
citation: CAMBER synthetic dataset synthetic-chw-plant-staging, generator chw_plant_staging (camber.datasets._synthetic), seed 137. Generated data, not measurements from any building.
timezone: naive generated clock (no DST); 15-minute samples from 2025-07-07 (a Monday) for 21 days
equipment: 1 chilled-water plant (chiller, cooling tower) as 5 scenario plants

fault_types.chiller_short_cycling: a chiller oversized for the load, starting and stopping every half hour
fault_types.chiller_left_on: a chiller left enabled around the clock, idling at a small part load at night and over the weekend
fault_types.no_cw_reset: the cooling tower held at a fixed 85 F instead of reset with the wet-bulb

full.description: all five plants (the same as default)

known_issues: Synthetic: generated by CAMBER's own model of a plant, not measured. It shows what the rules see, not how a real plant behaves; never cite it as evidence about real buildings.
15-minute samples: a chiller run shorter than 15 minutes is invisible, so the start counts are a floor.
